mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 5.0% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates a stagflationary risk that erodes corporate margins and consumer purchasing power, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a financial crisis, a housing starts level (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units indicates a severe housing market collapse that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400 during a financial crisis.

mechanism_narrative: Higher payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (relative to 2017 base) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession, a retail sales level (RSAFS) below 700,000 million dollars indicates weak consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 700000 during a recession.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a severe economic slowdown across both consumer and manufacturing sectors, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines and INDPRO declines.
